records.question: Top team leaders by equivalent new tickets this year

report.title: Top team leaders by equivalent new tickets this year
report.sql:
SELECT u.name AS team_leader_name, COUNT(pt.id) AS new_ticket_count FROM product_task pt JOIN users u ON pt.assign_team_leader = u.id WHERE pt.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND pt.created_at <= '2026-12-31' AND pt.is_deleted = 0 AND pt.assign_team_leader IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pt.assign_team_leader, u.name ORDER BY new_ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 500
report.explanation: This query counts new tickets (product_task records) created in 2026 for each team leader. It joins product_task with users to translate team leader IDs into names, filters for non-deleted tasks within the specified date range, groups by team leader, and orders by ticket count descending to show top performers.
assumptions: New tickets are defined as product_task records created within the year 2026
Team leaders are identified by the assign_team_leader field in product_task
The created_at field in product_task represents when the ticket was created
